note: The ticket is returned whole: a place must keep both conspiracies, a person ticket is accepted or returned as a whole, and a map design keeps its set share.

rows.note: Two independent blind reads (DR-20260928-NOHELP-REVIEW-FAST) both missed the declared lean (declared A; votes A 0, B 0, neither 2). Rework so one detail tilts it to its own side while the rival reading stays possible. Keep place, spot, lean, rival, pieces and axioms.

row.body: The map is open to a farm track, but the keyring rests beyond the drawn gate. Its tag is still tied on; the paper around the knot has torn in two.
row.title: The gate key on the far side
row.gloss: A gate route and its key no longer meet.
row.rival_reading: A farm worker could set a spare key beside a track while changing field access; a torn tag says nothing about an evacuation order.

rows.note: Passed its blind read; returned only because its ticket is returned whole. Redeliver it unchanged: its receipt stays valid while title, body, pieces and places are unchanged.

row.body: The seed bag is folded shut around the shovel handle. A straight line of dark soil runs from the blade to the bag's seam, but the shovel has no soil on its grip.
row.title: The seed bag holds a narrow trench
row.gloss: Seed stock and a freshly used tool were wrapped together.
row.rival_reading: A response crew could move seed stock and tools while clearing a farm; the clean grip could come from ordinary handling.

drift: Batch note (whole round, read once): a key ring appears in about ten of the 38 rows, a crop-row sketch in about eight and a water ring or stain in five. Not a return reason this round; vary objects and details in the redeliveries and in T0019 onward so a player does not meet the same arrangement at every place.
